gaps.sentence: They've postponed ___ the new bridge until spring.
We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.

gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.
too + adjective + to-infinitive: too young to stay.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.
